verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents an API, an MCP server, webhooks and an auto-renewal toggle. These are building blocks a user could wire into their own automations, or a single fixed renewal switch. None of them is a product-native way to define custom automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled jobs, rules or background agents. Building blocks and an adjacent toggle earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
